title: The House that Came in the Mail Again

sentences.en: Hello, beautiful nerds.
sentences.zh: 大家好，美丽的极客们。

sentences.en: This week, we're rebroadcasting one of my favorite episodes of the last few years about Sears Homes.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将重播过去几年中我最喜欢的一期节目，主题是西尔斯住宅（Sears Homes）。

sentences.en: I liked it so much that I put it as a piece of bonus content on the audio version of the book that Kurt and I wrote last year.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢这一期，以至于把它作为去年我和库尔特（Kurt）合著那本书的有声版中的附赠内容。

sentences.en: Speaking of, our first book, The 99% Invisible City, came out one year ago this week.
sentences.zh: 说到这儿，我们的第一本书《99%隐形城市》（The 99% Invisible City）在本周刚好出版一周年。

sentences.en: It peaked at number three on the New York Times bestseller list, and we were really excited about that.
sentences.zh: 它曾登上《纽约时报》畅销书排行榜第三名，我们对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: If you're into the show at all, I think you'll love the book.
sentences.zh: 如果你对我们的节目感兴趣，我想你也会喜欢这本书。

sentences.en: It's also a good gift for folks who are not into podcasts yet, but like this kind of nerdy stuff.
sentences.zh: 对于那些还没听过播客，但喜欢这类极客内容的人来说，它也是一份不错的礼物。

sentences.en: And if you're an audiobook person, you can listen to me read it to you for 10 and a half hours, which people seem to dig.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢听有声书，你可以听我为你朗读十个半小时，大家似乎都很喜欢。

sentences.en: We're on our semi-annual retreat this week, where we look back at all the episodes we've made and how we want to shape the show in the future.
sentences.zh: 本周我们正在进行半年一度的务虚会，回顾我们制作过的所有节目，并思考未来如何塑造节目风格。

sentences.en: So thank you for affording us this time to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以，感谢你们给予我们这段时间来做这件事。

sentences.en: We have a barn burner of a new episode next week.
sentences.zh: 下周我们将带来一期非常精彩的新节目。

sentences.en: It's all about a flag.
sentences.zh: 内容是关于一面旗帜。

sentences.en: So we'll be right back in our wheelhouse in no time.
sentences.zh: 所以我们很快就会回到我们最擅长的领域。

sentences.en: In the meantime, please enjoy this story for the first time, or even listen again.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，请尽情享受这个故事，或者再听一遍。

sentences.en: It is worth it listening again.
sentences.zh: 它值得再听一遍。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》（99% Invisible）。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯（Roman Mars）。

sentences.en: About eight weeks ago, one of the producers here at 99PI ordered a book.
sentences.zh: 大约八周前，99PI的一位制片人订购了一本书。

sentences.en: Our office receives a lot of books, but this one, this one was special.
sentences.zh: 我们的办公室经常收到很多书，但这一本，这一本很特别。

sentences.en: Everyone wanted to read it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想读它。

sentences.en: Okay, so first of all, this book is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 好吧，首先，这本书很漂亮。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Only it wasn't just any book.
sentences.zh: 只不过它不仅仅是一本书。

sentences.en: That's the producer, Joe Rosenberg.
sentences.zh: 那是制片人乔·罗森伯格（Joe Rosenberg）。

sentences.en: It was a catalog.
sentences.zh: 它是一本商品目录。

sentences.en: Oh my god, it's from 1908.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这是1908年的。

sentences.en: Catalog number 177 of The Great Pricemaker.
sentences.zh: 《伟大的价格制定者》（The Great Pricemaker）第177号目录。

sentences.en: Oh, there's so much stuff.
sentences.zh: 噢，这里面的东西真多。

sentences.en: The Sears and Roebuck mail order catalog was nearly omnipresent in early 20th century American life.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯·罗巴克（Sears and Roebuck）的邮购目录在20世纪初的美国生活中几乎无处不在。

sentences.en: In 1908, when this particular issue came out, one out of every five Americans were already subscribers.
sentences.zh: 1908年，当这一期目录发布时，每五个美国人中就有一个已经是订阅用户了。

sentences.en: So is this kind of like the Amazon warehouse before the Amazon warehouse?
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像亚马逊仓库出现之前的亚马逊仓库吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Anyone, anywhere in the country, could order this catalog.
sentences.zh: 全国任何地方的任何人都可以订购这本目录。

sentences.en: For free, look through it, and then have anything their heart desired delivered directly to their doorstep.
sentences.zh: 免费获取，翻阅它，然后把你心仪的任何东西直接送到家门口。

sentences.en: Like, seriously, anything.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的，任何东西。

sentences.en: Parasols and pipes.
sentences.zh: 遮阳伞和烟斗。

sentences.en: Really fancy-looking belts.
sentences.zh: 看起来非常时髦的腰带。

sentences.en: Ostrich feathers.
sentences.zh: 鸵鸟羽毛。

sentences.en: The world's best ostrich feathers.
sentences.zh: 世界上最好的鸵鸟羽毛。

sentences.en: Oh, headstones.
sentences.zh: 噢，还有墓碑。

sentences.en: At its height, the Sears catalog offered over 100,000 items on 1,400 pages.
sentences.zh: 在鼎盛时期，西尔斯目录在1400页的篇幅里提供了超过10万种商品。

sentences.en: It weighed four pounds.
sentences.zh: 它重达四磅。

sentences.en: Today, those 1,400 pages provide us with a snapshot of American life in the first decade of the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 今天，这1400页内容为我们提供了20世纪头十年美国生活的一个缩影。

sentences.en: 1596, our new Williams special single-strap buggy harness.
sentences.zh: 1596，我们新款威廉姆斯（Williams）特制单带马车挽具。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Wait, what is it?
sentences.zh: 等等，那是什么？

sentences.en: It's a sheep-shearing machine.
sentences.zh: 那是一台剪羊毛机。

sentences.en: Menstruation products have definitely evolved.
sentences.zh: 经期用品确实已经进化了。

sentences.en: The Sears catalog tells the tale of a world itemized.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯目录讲述了一个万物皆可列举的世界的故事。

sentences.en: But starting with this very issue, in 1908, the company that offered America everything began offering what just might be the most audacious, and in some ways, most necessary,
sentences.zh: 但从1908年的这一期开始，这家为美国提供一切的公司，开始提供可能最令人惊叹，在某些方面也是最必要的，

sentences.en: item of all.
sentences.zh: 商品。

sentences.en: And?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Wait.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.en: These are houses.
sentences.zh: 这些是房子。

sentences.en: On page 596, Sears subscribers would come across a drawing of a house.
sentences.zh: 在第596页，西尔斯的订阅者会看到一幅房屋的图纸。

sentences.en: Two stories, nine rooms, gabled roofs, and a price, $1,700.
sentences.zh: 两层楼，九个房间，人字形屋顶，价格1700美元。

sentences.en: Wait, $1,700 for, no.
sentences.zh: 等等，1700美元买，不。

sentences.en: I think the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我想是整栋房子。

sentences.en: For the house?
sentences.zh: 买房子？

sentences.en: Thing.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: From 1908 to 1940, the Sears Modern Home Program offered complete, full-size, mail-order houses to the would-be homeowner.
sentences.zh: 从1908年到1940年，西尔斯现代家居计划（Sears Modern Home Program）为准房主提供了完整的、全尺寸的邮购房屋。

sentences.en: What would come to be called kit homes.
sentences.zh: 也就是后来被称为“套件房屋”（kit homes）的东西。

sentences.en: Sears actually provided an entirely separate catalog for these kit homes, featuring dozens of different designs.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯实际上为这些套件房屋提供了一本完全独立的目录，里面有几十种不同的设计。

sentences.en: All you had to do was select your preferred model from the catalog, fill out the provided form, send in a check, and a few weeks later,
sentences.zh: 你所要做的就是从目录中选择你喜欢的型号，填写提供的表格，寄出一张支票，几周后，

sentences.en: everything you'd need would arrive in a train car.
sentences.zh: 你需要的一切都会装在火车车厢里运到。

sentences.en: Its door was secured with a small red wax seal, just like the seal on the back of a letter to the king or something.
sentences.zh: 车厢门上封着一个小红蜡印，就像给国王写信封底上的印章之类的东西。

sentences.en: It was to be broken only by you.
sentences.zh: 它只能由你亲自拆开。

sentences.en: You throw open the door to this box car, and you're looking at 12,000 pieces of framing lumber.
sentences.zh: 你推开这节货车车厢的门，映入眼帘的是12000块框架木材。

sentences.en: And 20,000 cedar shakes.
sentences.zh: 还有20000片雪松木瓦。

sentences.en: That's Rosemary Thornton, an architectural historian and the author of The Houses That Sears Built.
sentences.zh: 那是罗斯玛丽·桑顿（Rosemary Thornton），一位建筑历史学家，也是《西尔斯建造的房子》（The Houses That Sears Built）的作者。

sentences.en: She says that that train car also came with every single door, every single doorknob, a fold-away ironing board for your kitchen, even the mantle for the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 她说那节火车车厢里还装有每一扇门、每一个门把手、一个厨房折叠熨衣板，甚至还有壁炉的壁炉架。

sentences.en: And then you would begin the process of dutifully loading it either onto your mule and cart or your Model T.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以开始把它们装上你的骡车或T型车，勤勤恳恳地运回家了。

sentences.en: The lumber came pre-cut, kind of like a giant Ikea set, along with, in true Ikea style, an instruction booklet.
sentences.zh: 木材是预先切割好的，有点像巨大的宜家套装，而且还有一本典型的宜家风格说明书。

sentences.en: If you provided the foundation, Sears promised that working without a carpenter and only rudimentary skills, you could finish your Sears mail-order home in less than 90 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你准备好了地基，西尔斯承诺，即使没有木匠，仅凭基础技能，你也能在不到90天内完成你的西尔斯邮购房屋。

sentences.en: Although Rosemary says those instructions also came with a warning.
sentences.zh: 尽管罗斯玛丽说这些说明书里也附带了一个警告。

sentences.en: Do not accept anyone's advice on how this house should be built.
sentences.zh: 不要接受任何人关于这栋房子应该如何建造的建议。

sentences.en: Follow this instruction manual and do not deviate.
sentences.zh: 遵循这本说明手册，不要偏离。

sentences.en: So if the old wizened carpenter comes by and says, I wouldn't build it that way, and Sears is warning you up front, do not listen to that man.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有个老木匠走过来跟你说，我不建议那样盖，而西尔斯事先警告过你，千万别听那个人的。

sentences.en: Sears would go on to ship out some 75,000 homes across the country.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯最终在全国范围内运送了约75000栋房屋。

sentences.en: In doing so, they helped replace the idea that each new house needed to be built from scratch with the promise that new homes could be standardized, affordable,
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，他们帮助取代了那种“每栋新房都需要从零开始建造”的观念，取而代之的是一种承诺：新房可以标准化、负担得起，

sentences.en: and within reach of every family.
sentences.zh: 并且每个家庭都触手可及。

sentences.en: Long before the advent of housing developments in the modern suburb, it was the Sears kit home that gave Americans their first taste of 20th century domestic life.
sentences.zh: 在现代郊区住房开发出现很久之前，正是西尔斯的套件房屋让美国人第一次尝到了20世纪家庭生活的滋味。

sentences.en: But it's also a chapter of housing history that was almost loSt.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一段几乎被遗忘的住房历史。

sentences.en: Sears was not the first company to offer kit homes, nor even the first mail-order catalog.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯并不是第一家提供套件房屋的公司，甚至也不是第一家邮购目录公司。

sentences.en: But it came to dominate mail-order because its founder, Richard Sears, was that thing that so many people would claim to be over the course of the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 但它最终统治了邮购市场，因为它的创始人理查德·西尔斯（Richard Sears）具备了20世纪许多人声称自己拥有，

sentences.en: But very few actually were.
sentences.zh: 但实际上很少有人真正拥有的特质。

sentences.en: He was a marketing genius.
sentences.zh: 他是一位营销天才。

sentences.en: He just did so many things.
sentences.zh: 他做了太多事情了。

sentences.en: And one of my favorites is that Sears knew that most farm households would have both the Montgomery Ward and the Sears Roebuck catalog in the household.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的一点是，西尔斯知道大多数农户家里都会同时有蒙哥马利·沃德（Montgomery Ward）和西尔斯·罗巴克的目录。

sentences.en: So he purposefully made his catalog just a little bit less wide and a little bit less tall than the Montgomery Ward catalog,
sentences.zh: 所以他特意把自己的目录做得比蒙哥马利·沃德的目录稍微窄一点、矮一点，

sentences.en: knowing that when the farmhouse wife was tidying things up, she would naturally put the Sears Roebuck catalog on top of the Montgomery Ward catalog.
sentences.zh: 因为他知道，当农场主太太整理东西时，她会自然而然地把西尔斯·罗巴克的目录放在蒙哥马利·沃德的目录上面。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个细节。

sentences.en: By 1907, Sears and Roebuck was selling the then equivalent of $1.3 billion of merchandise to American families every year.
sentences.zh: 到1907年，西尔斯·罗巴克每年向美国家庭销售的商品价值相当于现在的13亿美元。

sentences.en: And it's around this time that Richard Sears saw a way to sell even more.
sentences.zh: 就在这个时候，理查德·西尔斯看到了进一步扩大销售的途径。

sentences.en: Most American families were still living in multi-generational housing.
sentences.zh: 大多数美国家庭当时仍然居住在多代同堂的房子里。

sentences.en: The reigning paradigm of the middle class was the Victorian home,
sentences.zh: 中产阶级的主流范式是维多利亚式住宅，

sentences.en: with its many little rooms divvying up children, uncles, and grandparents.
sentences.zh: 里面有许多小房间，把孩子、叔叔和祖父母隔开。

sentences.en: Sears looked at this idyllic scene of families living in harmony and saw a wasted opportunity.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯看着这幅家庭和睦相处的田园诗般的场景，却看到了一个被浪费的机会。

sentences.en: Why should newlyweds move into old homes with old things when they can move into new homes and fill them with new things from Sears?
sentences.zh: 为什么新婚夫妇要搬进旧房子用旧东西，当他们可以搬进新房子，并用西尔斯的新东西填满它们呢？

sentences.en: And thus, the Sears Modern Home Program was born.
sentences.zh: 于是，西尔斯现代家居计划诞生了。

sentences.en: And it was a hit, particularly after the end of World War I, when the influx of returning veterans triggered a need for more housing.
sentences.zh: 它非常成功，特别是在第一次世界大战结束后，退伍军人的涌入引发了对住房的巨大需求。

sentences.en: And there was literature that said, if you really love this country, if you really want to do right by America, buy a house, build a house.
sentences.zh: 当时还有文学作品说，如果你真的爱这个国家，如果你真的想为美国做点贡献，那就买房，盖房。

sentences.en: And that's when Kit Holmes really took off.
sentences.zh: 那就是套件房屋真正兴起的时候。

sentences.en: Sears cut the lumber for almost all of these homes ready to order in giant mills situated across the country.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯在全国各地的巨型工厂里，将这些房屋所需的木材几乎全部切割好，随时准备发货。

sentences.en: The largest in Carroll, Illinois, at the confluence of the Mississippi and Ohio Rivers, covered nearly 40 acres.
sentences.zh: 位于伊利诺伊州卡罗尔（Carroll），密西西比河和俄亥俄河交汇处最大的工厂，占地近40英亩。

sentences.en: And the sheer variety of homes it shipped out was staggering.
sentences.zh: 而且它运出的房屋种类之多令人震惊。

sentences.en: That first Modern Homes catalog had over 40 models to choose from.
sentences.zh: 第一本现代家居目录有40多种型号可供选择。

sentences.en: But Sears would go on to offer 447 different designs.
sentences.zh: 但西尔斯最终提供了447种不同的设计。

sentences.en: Every house in the catalog had a name befitting its architectural aspirations.
sentences.zh: 目录中的每一栋房子都有一个与其建筑抱负相称的名字。

sentences.en: So if you always dreamed of living in a California Mission-style home, but you couldn't actually move to California,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你一直梦想住在加州教会风格的房子里，但你无法搬到加州，

sentences.en: you might consider purchasing Sears Alhambra model.
sentences.zh: 你可能会考虑购买西尔斯的阿罕布拉（Alhambra）型号。

sentences.en: Other styles included the craftsman-style Winona and the Dutch colonial Martha Washington.
sentences.zh: 其他风格包括工匠风格的威诺纳（Winona）和荷兰殖民风格的玛莎·华盛顿（Martha Washington）。

sentences.en: They range from everything from what I would call a hunter's cabin, literally a two-room house for $200 or $300,
sentences.zh: 它们的范围涵盖了从我所说的“猎人小屋”（实际上是两间房的房子，售价200或300美元），

sentences.en: to the Sears Magnolia, which was 2,900 square feet, two full bathrooms upstairs, a half-bathroom downstairs,
sentences.zh: 到西尔斯的木兰（Magnolia）型号，它有2900平方英尺，楼上有两个全套浴室，楼下有一个半卫，

sentences.en: two full fireplaces, a den, even had servants' quarters and a servants' private bath.
sentences.zh: 两个完整的壁炉，一个书房，甚至还有仆人房和仆人专用浴室。

sentences.en: Sears even offered a six-classroom schoolhouse, complete with an auditorium and library.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯甚至提供过六间教室的校舍，配有礼堂和图书馆。

sentences.en: But mostly, it was homes.
sentences.zh: 但主要还是住宅。

sentences.en: Big, beautiful, empty homes, just waiting to be filled with things.
sentences.zh: 又大、又美、空荡荡的房子，只等着被各种东西填满。

sentences.en: In fact, if you look at some of the old floor plans, it'll feature the living room, the dining room, the bedrooms,
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你看一些旧的平面图，它会标出客厅、餐厅、卧室，

sentences.en: but then it will say, place for a graphophone, spot for a piano, place for two tufted chairs.
sentences.zh: 但随后它会写上：留声机位置、钢琴位置、两把簇绒椅位置。

sentences.en: And so he was kind of showing people how to stuff their houses with stuff from the Sears robot catalog.
sentences.zh: 所以他是在向人们展示如何用西尔斯·罗巴克目录里的东西来填满他们的房子。

sentences.en: And consumers obliged.
sentences.zh: 消费者也照做了。

sentences.en: There are tales of first-time homeowners who bought what you might call a turnkey operation from the catalog.
sentences.zh: 有一些关于首次购房者的故事，他们从目录中购买了所谓的“交钥匙”方案。

sentences.en: The house, the furniture, and the many little things that rested on the furniture.
sentences.zh: 房子、家具，以及摆在家具上的许多小物件。

sentences.en: A whole new life, all from Sears.
sentences.zh: 全新的生活，一切都来自西尔斯。

sentences.en: In part because the company used its considerable marketing savvy to make it clear that building your house was going to be easy.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是该公司利用其相当可观的营销头脑，明确表示建造你的房子将会非常容易。

sentences.en: With a pre-designed home, you didn't need an architect.
sentences.zh: 有了预先设计的房子，你就不需要建筑师了。

sentences.en: And with the pre-cut lumber frame, you didn't need a carpenter either.
sentences.zh: 有了预先切割的木框架，你也不需要木匠了。

sentences.en: You could treat it like any other consumer item.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它当作任何其他消费品来对待。

sentences.en: Sears even had this ad in the front of the catalog.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯甚至在目录的前面刊登过这则广告。

sentences.en: It showed two Rodessa models, one of Sears' most popular houses, being built side by side.
sentences.zh: 它展示了两个罗德萨（Rodessa）型号（西尔斯最受欢迎的房子之一）并排建造的过程。

sentences.en: One was built from scratch, essentially, using ordinary building materials and uncut stick lumber.
sentences.zh: 一个是基本上从零开始建造的，使用普通的建筑材料和未切割的木料。

sentences.en: The other with pre-cut lumber.
sentences.zh: 另一个是用预切割木材建造的。

sentences.en: In the ad, the house with the stick lumber sits unfinished.
sentences.zh: 在广告中，用普通木料盖的房子还没完工。

sentences.en: People are collapsed in the front yard, exhausted.
sentences.zh: 人们累得瘫倒在前院。

sentences.en: And then the house where it was built with the pre-cut lumber,
sentences.zh: 而另一边，用预切割木材建造的房子，

sentences.en: they're sitting on the porch with a mint julep, you know, having just the time of their life.
sentences.zh: 他们正坐在门廊上喝着薄荷朱利酒，你知道，过着最惬意的生活。

sentences.en: And so although many people did hire a contractor to build their Sears home, many did not.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管许多人确实雇佣了承包商来建造他们的西尔斯住宅，但也有许多人没有这样做。

sentences.en: And I have heard many stories about families receiving their kit home
sentences.zh: 我听过很多关于家庭收到他们的套件房屋，

sentences.en: and calling on neighbors to help them come out and start the process of building the house.
sentences.zh: 并呼吁邻居来帮忙，开始建造房子的故事。

sentences.en: For many families, these were their first homes with things like central heating and insulation.
sentences.zh: 对于许多家庭来说，这些是他们第一栋拥有中央供暖和隔热设施的房子。

sentences.en: In some neighborhoods, a Sears kit home might be the only house on the block with electricity.
sentences.zh: 在一些社区，西尔斯套件房屋可能是街区里唯一通电的房子。

sentences.en: And in 1911, Sears began offering competitive mortgages to their customers,
sentences.zh: 1911年，西尔斯开始向客户提供有竞争力的抵押贷款，

sentences.en: which also helped people in neighborhoods of color get around the practice of redlining.
sentences.zh: 这也帮助了有色人种社区的人们绕过了“红线政策”（redlining）。

sentences.en: And redlining just meant that the bankers and the mortgage lenders would draw a line around neighborhoods
sentences.zh: 红线政策意味着银行家和抵押贷款机构会在地图上划定社区范围，

sentences.en: where they would not loan money.
sentences.zh: 在这些范围内他们不会发放贷款。

sentences.en: So Sears didn't do any of that.
sentences.zh: 所以西尔斯没有参与任何这种行为。

sentences.en: And that enabled immigrants, men and women of color, and single women
sentences.zh: 这使得移民、有色人种男女以及单身女性能够拥有自己的家。

sentences.en: who would otherwise never have a chance of becoming a homeowner
sentences.zh: 那些原本绝无可能成为房主的人

sentences.en: to have indoor plumbing for the first time.
sentences.zh: 第一次用上了室内管道设施。

sentences.en: But then the company discovered that it had made a mistake,
sentences.zh: 但后来公司发现自己犯了个错，

sentences.en: one that will probably sound all too familiar.
sentences.zh: 一个听起来可能再熟悉不过的错误。

sentences.en: From the beginning, Sears had made sure their mortgage policy
sentences.zh: 从一开始，西尔斯就确保他们的抵押贷款政策

sentences.en: was like everything else in their catalog, obtainable.
sentences.zh: 就像他们目录里的其他商品一样，触手可及。

sentences.en: The application form was only half a page long,
sentences.zh: 申请表只有半页纸长，

sentences.en: and almost everyone who applied for a mortgage qualified,
sentences.zh: 几乎每个申请抵押贷款的人都符合条件，

sentences.en: meaning that the average Sears homeowner was also in debt to Sears.
sentences.zh: 这意味着普通的西尔斯房主同时也欠着西尔斯的债。

sentences.en: In the roaring 20s, when interest rates were low and liquidity high,
sentences.zh: 在繁荣的20年代，利率低、流动性高，

sentences.en: it wasn't a problem.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是问题。

sentences.en: But when the Great Depression hit, things got ugly faSt.
sentences.zh: 但当大萧条来袭时，情况迅速恶化。

sentences.en: The company ended up foreclosing on tens of thousands of its very own customers.
sentences.zh: 公司最终没收了成千上万名自家客户的房产。

sentences.en: I mean, it was an emotional devastation.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那简直是情感上的毁灭。

sentences.en: We all know the Great Depression was horrible for so many reasons,
sentences.zh: 我们都知道大萧条因为种种原因极其可怕，

sentences.en: but losing a home that you had built with your own two hands
sentences.zh: 但失去一栋你亲手建造的房子，

sentences.en: just seems like such a twist of the knife.
sentences.zh: 简直就像是在伤口上撒盐。

sentences.en: For Sears, it was a PR disaster.
sentences.zh: 对西尔斯来说，这是一场公关灾难。

sentences.en: Rosemary remembers talking to someone in 2003
sentences.zh: 罗斯玛丽记得2003年曾与人交谈，

sentences.en: who described how Sears had foreclosed on their grandparents' home in 1931,
sentences.zh: 那人描述了西尔斯如何在1931年没收了他们祖父母的房子，

sentences.en: the very same home Sears had sold them a decade earlier.
sentences.zh: 而那正是十年前西尔斯卖给他们的同一栋房子。

sentences.en: And he said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: for two generations, our family never patronized Sears ever again.
sentences.zh: 两代人以来，我们家再也没有光顾过西尔斯。

sentences.en: I mean, those are strong feelings to go from 1931 to 2003.
sentences.zh: 我是说，从1931年到2003年，这种怨恨真是根深蒂固。

sentences.en: After years of declining sales, Sears would finally close its modern homes department in 1940.
sentences.zh: 在经历了多年的销售下滑后，西尔斯最终在1940年关闭了现代住宅部门。

sentences.en: A few other kit home manufacturers, ones that hadn't sold mortgages, they survived.
sentences.zh: 其他几家没有提供抵押贷款的套件房屋制造商幸存了下来。

sentences.en: But the Sears kit home boom was over.
sentences.zh: 但西尔斯的套件房屋热潮结束了。

sentences.en: Then came World War II, and with it, the next modern housing boom,
sentences.zh: 随后是第二次世界大战，随之而来的是下一次现代住房热潮，

sentences.en: featuring the rise of the suburbs and the prefab home,
sentences.zh: 郊区的兴起和预制房屋的出现，

sentences.en: the homes so many of us live in today.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们今天许多人居住的房子。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, most of the Sears homes, the Alhambras, the Argyles, the Magnolias,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，大多数西尔斯房屋，比如Alhambra、Argyle、Magnolia系列，

sentences.en: they ended up being sold to new owners who didn't know what they bought or didn't care to know.
sentences.zh: 最终被卖给了新房主，他们要么不知道自己买了什么，要么根本不在乎。

sentences.en: Despite the high quality of the materials,
sentences.zh: 尽管材料质量很高，

sentences.en: over the decades as the company became associated with convenience over and above quality,
sentences.zh: 但几十年来，随着公司变得以便利而非质量著称，

sentences.en: no one wanted to admit that they lived in a home that came from the Sears catalog.
sentences.zh: 没人愿意承认自己住的是西尔斯目录里卖的房子。

sentences.en: It was embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 这很丢人。

sentences.en: So a lot of them ended up being renovated beyond recognition.
sentences.zh: 所以很多房子被翻修得面目全非。

sentences.en: Many were torn down.
sentences.zh: 许多被拆除了。

sentences.en: Others were simply abandoned.
sentences.zh: 其他的则干脆被废弃了。

sentences.en: And as for where to find the ones that remain?
sentences.zh: 至于去哪里找剩下的那些呢？

sentences.en: Unfortunately, after World War II, during a corporate house cleaning, the sales records were destroyed.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，二战后，在一次公司大清理中，销售记录被销毁了。

sentences.en: So these records are missing.
sentences.zh: 所以这些记录丢失了。

sentences.en: Records are gone, chief.
sentences.zh: 记录都没了，头儿。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: They're not just missing.
sentences.zh: 它们不仅仅是丢失了。

sentences.en: They're gone.
sentences.zh: 它们彻底消失了。

sentences.en: They're gone.
sentences.zh: 它们消失了。

sentences.en: They're in somebody's burn pile.
sentences.zh: 它们在某人的焚烧堆里。

sentences.en: All that stuff was disposed of.
sentences.zh: 所有那些资料都被处理掉了。

sentences.en: So the only way to find these houses today is literally one by one.
sentences.zh: 所以今天找到这些房子的唯一方法，只能是挨家挨户地找。

sentences.en: A few weeks after I interviewed Rosemary, I went to see some of the last remaining Sears homes outside of Cairo, Illinois,
sentences.zh: 在采访罗斯玛丽几周后，我去看了一些位于伊利诺伊州开罗市外仅存的西尔斯房屋，

sentences.en: the town where Sears' largest mill had once stood.
sentences.zh: 那个镇上曾经矗立着西尔斯最大的工厂。

sentences.en: When I got there, the only sign that there had ever been anything there was the name of an overgrown back road, Sears,
sentences.zh: 当我到达那里时，唯一能证明这里曾经有东西的痕迹，就是一条杂草丛生的乡间小路的名字——“西尔斯”，

sentences.en: leading to two tiny houses, two Sears Rodessa models, sitting next to each other.
sentences.zh: 它通向两栋并排的小房子，两栋西尔斯Rodessa型号的住宅。

sentences.en: They were the twin Rodessa models from that original advertisement, with the two homes being built, one fast, one slow, side by side.
sentences.zh: 它们就是那则原始广告中的那对Rodessa双胞胎模型，两栋房子并排建造，一栋快，一栋慢。

sentences.en: Now they were in so-so shape, but somehow they'd outlived the mill that built them here on Sears-Roebuck Road.
sentences.zh: 现在它们状况一般，但不知何故，它们比当年在西尔斯-罗巴克路上建造它们的工厂活得更久。

sentences.en: I stopped to take a look, and 30 seconds later, a man waved me inside.
sentences.zh: 我停下来看了一眼，30秒后，一个男人向我招手让我进去。

sentences.en: They're just noisy.
sentences.zh: 它们只是吵闹而已。

sentences.en: They don't mean no...
sentences.zh: 它们没别的意思……

sentences.en: They try to scare you off, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想它们是想把你吓跑。

sentences.en: Guy Parks greeted me wearing an old mechanic's jumpsuit.
sentences.zh: 盖伊·帕克斯穿着一件旧机械师连体服迎接了我。

sentences.en: As he settled into an easy chair in the living room, he told me that he'd lived on and off in Cairo since the 1950s,
sentences.zh: 当他在客厅的安乐椅上坐下时，他告诉我，自20世纪50年代以来，他断断续续地住在开罗，

sentences.en: and that he first laid eyes on this Rodessa nearly 35 years ago.
sentences.zh: 他第一次见到这栋Rodessa是在近35年前。

sentences.en: And the house was derelict.
sentences.zh: 当时这房子已经破败不堪。

sentences.en: I mean, it was...
sentences.zh: 我是说，它……

sentences.en: The roof was leaking.
sentences.zh: 屋顶在漏水。

sentences.en: The windows were broke out.
sentences.zh: 窗户都破了。

sentences.en: It was still safe, but it was old.
sentences.zh: 它还算稳固，但太老了。

sentences.en: Guy ran into the owner a little while later, and the owner said to him,
sentences.zh: 盖伊不久后遇到了房主，房主对他说，

sentences.en: how about I sell you the place, and you fix it up?
sentences.zh: 我把这地方卖给你，你把它修好怎么样？

sentences.en: I said, oh hell, I can't buy nothing.
sentences.zh: 我说，天哪，我什么都买不起。

sentences.en: I ain't saved a dollar out of my last check.
sentences.zh: 我上一张工资支票里连一美元都没存下。

sentences.en: He said, I'll make it where you can buy it.
sentences.zh: 他说，我会让你买得起的。

sentences.en: He said, 15.
I'll sell it to you for 15.
sentences.zh: 我卖给你，只要15。

sentences.en: I thought he meant thousands.
sentences.zh: 我以为他说的是几千。

sentences.en: I said, man, I wouldn't get that far if it's up in shape.
sentences.zh: 我说，伙计，如果它状况好的话，我可拿不出那么多钱。

sentences.en: He said, I'm talking about hundreds.
sentences.zh: 他说，我说的是几百。

sentences.en: I said, you wait right here.
sentences.zh: 我说，你就在这儿等着。

sentences.en: So Guy went out, came back an hour later with the cash, and bought the Rodessa for $1,500 on the spot.
sentences.zh: 于是盖伊出门，一小时后带着现金回来，当场以1500美元买下了这栋Rodessa。

sentences.en: Eventually, he'd buy the Rodessa next to it, too.
sentences.zh: 后来，他也买下了隔壁的那栋Rodessa。

sentences.en: The twin.
sentences.zh: 那栋双胞胎房子。

sentences.en: His son lives there now.
sentences.zh: 他儿子现在住在那儿。

sentences.en: And I hate to say this, but I'm dumb enough that I spent everything I made for the next five, six years on this place.
sentences.zh: 我不想这么说，但我真是笨到家了，接下来的五六年里，我把我赚的所有钱都花在了这房子上。

sentences.en: Trying to make it right.
sentences.zh: 试图把它修好。

sentences.en: Did you know that it was a Sears catwalk home?
sentences.zh: 你知道这是西尔斯的套件房屋吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I knew all these were Sears homes, because the man that lived down on the corner, he worked for Sears.
sentences.zh: 知道，我知道这些都是西尔斯的房子，因为住在拐角处的那个人，他曾在西尔斯工作。

sentences.en: Did he tell you any stories about the mill?
sentences.zh: 他给你讲过关于工厂的故事吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，讲过。

sentences.en: But he always told me the bad stuff.
sentences.zh: 但他总是告诉我那些糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: Guy's neighbor told him that a job at the mill had been hard, dangerous work.
sentences.zh: 盖伊的邻居告诉他，在工厂工作是份辛苦且危险的工作。

sentences.en: As with a lot of mills in the area, it wasn't uncommon to see employees missing fingers.
sentences.zh: 和该地区的许多工厂一样，员工缺胳膊少指头并不罕见。

sentences.en: When the Sears Modern Home Department closed, the workers purchased the plant and switched to making crates for bombers during World War II.
sentences.zh: 当西尔斯现代住宅部门关闭时，工人们买下了工厂，并在二战期间转为生产轰炸机板条箱。

sentences.en: After that, they tried making their own kid homes under a new name.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他们尝试以新的名字制造自己的套件房屋。

sentences.en: But ultimately, they couldn't hold on.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他们没能坚持下去。

sentences.en: The mill closed in 1955.
sentences.zh: 工厂于1955年关闭。

sentences.en: They didn't make very many homes after that.
sentences.zh: 在那之后他们没造多少房子。

sentences.en: I think this one down on the end, the little yellow house, was probably the last one they built.
sentences.zh: 我想尽头那栋黄色的小房子，可能就是他们造的最后一栋。

sentences.en: And it was just a little shotgun house.
sentences.zh: 那只是个小小的“枪管屋”。

sentences.en: My wife's sister lived there until she died.
sentences.zh: 我妻子的妹妹一直住在那儿，直到她去世。

sentences.en: Even Guy's house isn't very Sears anymore.
sentences.zh: 甚至盖伊的房子现在也不太像西尔斯的了。

sentences.en: He's replaced a lot of the original parts over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他更换了许多原始部件。

sentences.en: See that front door?
sentences.zh: 看到那扇前门了吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 看到了。

sentences.en: The only thing in this house that's in this room right here that's original was that front door.
sentences.zh: 这房子里，这间屋子里，唯一原始的东西就是那扇前门。

sentences.en: Sears door.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯的门。

sentences.en: Before Sears of race riots gutted downtown Cairo in the 1960s, the town had nearly 100 other Sears homes.
sentences.zh: 在西尔斯和种族骚乱摧毁开罗市中心之前，镇上还有近100栋西尔斯房屋。

sentences.en: Now maybe only a third of them are left.
sentences.zh: 现在可能只剩下三分之一了。

sentences.en: Guy watched as the rest were abandoned or reduced to rubble.
sentences.zh: 盖伊眼睁睁看着其余的被废弃或沦为瓦砾。

sentences.en: And the downtown just kept going down, going down, going down.
sentences.zh: 市中心一直在衰落，一直在衰落，一直在衰落。

sentences.en: You could see every month or so there'd be another business gone.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到每个月左右就会有一家企业倒闭。

sentences.en: Finally, there was nothing down there but derelict buildings that's falling down.
sentences.zh: 最后，那里除了摇摇欲坠的破败建筑外，什么都没有了。

sentences.en: And since then, all that's gone.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，一切都没了。

sentences.en: It's just, it's all gone.
sentences.zh: 就是这样，一切都消失了。

sentences.en: It's nothing the same.
sentences.zh: 什么都不一样了。

sentences.en: For a long time, Guy Parks' little Rodessa and its twin were just two of a small handful of Sears homes that had been located and identified.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，盖伊·帕克斯的小Rodessa和它的双胞胎房子，只是少数被定位和识别出来的西尔斯房屋中的两栋。

sentences.en: When Guy bought his house, of the 75,000 kit homes that Sears built and shipped,
sentences.zh: 当盖伊买下他的房子时，在西尔斯建造并运出的75000栋套件房屋中，

sentences.en: maybe 5% had been properly documented.
sentences.zh: 可能只有5%得到了妥善记录。

sentences.en: Most sat undiscovered.
sentences.zh: 大多数都未被发现。

sentences.en: If you lived in a Sears house, chances are you didn't even know it.
sentences.zh: 如果你住在一栋西尔斯房子里，你很可能根本不知道。

sentences.en: But a little over 20 years ago, one woman took a big step towards changing that.
sentences.zh: 但20多年前，一位女性在改变这一现状方面迈出了一大步。

sentences.en: Although, as she herself would be the first to admit, she didn't really mean to.
sentences.zh: 尽管她自己会第一个承认，她并不是真的有意为之。

sentences.en: It's pure serendipity that I ended up in this field.
sentences.zh: 我最终进入这个领域纯属偶然。

sentences.en: This is Rebecca Hunter.
sentences.zh: 这就是丽贝卡·亨特。

sentences.en: And no, she doesn't live in a Sears home.
sentences.zh: 不，她不住在西尔斯的房子里。

sentences.en: But she does live in a town on the other end of Illinois, a little west of Chicago on the Fox River.
sentences.zh: 但她确实住在伊利诺伊州的另一端，芝加哥以西一点的福克斯河畔的一个小镇。

sentences.en: It's called Elgin.
sentences.zh: 它叫埃尔金。

sentences.en: And unlike Caro, Elgin was not known for Sears homes.
sentences.zh: 和开罗不同，埃尔金并不以西尔斯房屋闻名。

sentences.en: When Rebecca first got there in the mid-90s, almost no one there, herself included, knew what a Sears house was.
sentences.zh: 当丽贝卡90年代中期第一次到那里时，几乎没人，包括她自己，知道什么是西尔斯房子。

sentences.en: Then my partner died in 1995, and I was doing everything because it helped.
sentences.zh: 后来我的伴侣在1995年去世了，我当时什么都做，因为这能让我好受点。

sentences.en: And that's how Rebecca ended up at the local library, where she happened upon a book about Sears homes,
sentences.zh: 这就是丽贝卡最终去当地图书馆的原因，在那里她偶然发现了一本关于西尔斯房屋的书，

sentences.en: which contained old catalog images of the various models, which would mean nothing,
sentences.zh: 里面有各种型号的旧目录图片，这本没什么意义，

sentences.en: except that one bitterly cold day in February, 1997.
sentences.zh: 除了1997年2月一个寒冷刺骨的日子。

sentences.en: That book happened to be lying on the dining room table.
sentences.zh: 那本书恰好放在餐桌上。

sentences.en: And I picked it up, and I said, oh, ha-ha, I wonder if I could walk around my neighborhood and find one of these houses.
sentences.zh: 我把它拿起来说，哦，哈哈，不知道我能不能在附近走走，找到这些房子中的一栋。

sentences.en: That would be really funny.
sentences.zh: 那会很有趣。

sentences.en: And so I picked up the book, and I set about walking in my neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 于是我拿起书，开始在附近散步。

sentences.en: How many were you realistically expecting to find?
sentences.zh: 你实际上期望找到多少栋？

sentences.en: I wasn't expecting to find any.
sentences.zh: 我没指望能找到任何一栋。

sentences.en: It was really kind of fun.
sentences.zh: 这真的挺有趣的。

sentences.en: You know, I had a goal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有一个目标。

sentences.en: I had a mission, and I forgot about the cold.
sentences.zh: 我有一个使命，我把寒冷都忘了。

sentences.en: And then, after, oh, I don't know, 10, 15 minutes,
sentences.zh: 然后，过了，哦，我不知道，10、15分钟，

sentences.en: I was walking down Plum Street, and I saw this house, and I instantly knew it was a Sears.
sentences.zh: 我沿着李子街走，看到了这栋房子，我立刻就知道它是西尔斯的。

sentences.en: Right there, after almost zero effort, boom, a Sears house.
sentences.zh: 就在那儿，几乎没费什么力气，砰，一栋西尔斯房子。

sentences.en: Rebecca looks at the house, looks at the book, looks at the house, looks at the book,
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡看看房子，看看书，看看房子，看看书，

sentences.en: and it's a match.
sentences.zh: 完全吻合。

sentences.en: Craftsman-style, tapered porch columns, the Avalon model.
sentences.zh: 工匠风格，锥形门廊柱，Avalon型号。

sentences.en: Then I said, huh, I wonder if I could walk around my neighborhood and find another one.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，呵，不知道我能不能在附近走走，再找到一栋。

sentences.en: And so I did.
sentences.zh: 于是我就这么做了。

sentences.en: On walk after walk, Rebecca kept finding Sears models.
sentences.zh: 在一次又一次的步行中，丽贝卡不断发现西尔斯（Sears）的房型。

sentences.en: The Mitchell, the Crescent, the Valonia.
sentences.zh: 比如米切尔（The Mitchell）、克雷森特（The Crescent）、瓦洛尼亚（The Valonia）。

sentences.en: Then there was the Betsy Ross, the Osborne, and the Alhambra.
sentences.zh: 还有贝齐·罗斯（The Betsy Ross）、奥斯本（The Osborne）和阿罕布拉（The Alhambra）。

sentences.en: In fact, there's one street that has the sunlight model on one side of the street,
sentences.zh: 事实上，有一条街的一侧是“阳光”房型，

sentences.en: and the opposite is the starlight.
sentences.zh: 而对面则是“星光”房型。

sentences.en: So you have a sunlight and a starlight right across the street from each other.
sentences.zh: 所以你会看到“阳光”和“星光”房型就在马路对面彼此相对。

sentences.en: But Rebecca wanted to confirm that these were Sears homes.
sentences.zh: 但丽贝卡想确认这些确实是西尔斯住宅。

sentences.en: So she sent a mailer out, asking each resident to go and inspect the basement.
sentences.zh: 于是她寄出了传单，要求每位住户去检查一下地下室。

sentences.en: When they did, most discovered beams bearing a special stamp with a part number from Sears.
sentences.zh: 当他们照做时，大多数人发现了带有西尔斯零件编号特殊印章的横梁。

sentences.en: Others found shipping labels from Sears on the back of attic baseboards.
sentences.zh: 其他人则在阁楼踢脚板背面发现了西尔斯的装运标签。

sentences.en: Still others managed to find their home's original Sears blueprints.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人设法找到了他们家原始的西尔斯蓝图。

sentences.en: And Rebecca's not even done.
sentences.zh: 而且丽贝卡的工作还没结束。

sentences.en: There are still more houses waiting to be investigated.
sentences.zh: 还有更多的房子等着被调查。

sentences.en: What did the total number of houses in Elgin number be?
sentences.zh: 埃尔金（Elgin）的西尔斯住宅总数是多少？

sentences.en: At the moment, I think we are at 237 Sears houses and about 100 from other companies.
sentences.zh: 目前，我想我们已经找到了237栋西尔斯住宅，以及大约100栋来自其他公司的住宅。

sentences.en: What's more, most of the homes Rebecca found looked like they were straight out of the catalog.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，丽贝卡发现的大多数房子看起来就像刚从目录里搬出来的一样。

sentences.en: They'd barely been altered since the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪20年代以来，它们几乎没有被改动过。

sentences.en: That's why she was able to find so many.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么她能找到这么多。

sentences.en: Because the homes could still be recognized.
sentences.zh: 因为这些房子依然可以被辨认出来。

sentences.en: And there was a specific reason why.
sentences.zh: 而且这背后有一个特定的原因。

sentences.en: When the Elgin watch factory, which had employed a quarter of the town, closed in 1964, Elgin entered a localized recession,
sentences.zh: 当雇佣了全镇四分之一人口的埃尔金手表厂在1964年倒闭时，埃尔金进入了局部经济衰退，

sentences.en: sparing it from the renovation craze of the 60s and 70s.
sentences.zh: 这使它免于60和70年代的翻新热潮。

sentences.en: Instead, Elgin Sears' home simply sat there, through the decades, untouched.
sentences.zh: 相反，埃尔金的西尔斯住宅就这样静静地坐落在那儿，几十年来未受触动。

sentences.en: Does anyone ever point out the fact that the closing of the watch factory froze the houses in time?
sentences.zh: 有没有人指出过手表厂的倒闭让这些房子在时间中凝固了这一事实？

sentences.en: Oh yeah, we talk about that.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，我们谈论过这个。

sentences.en: We love it.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢这样。

sentences.en: We love it.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢这样。

sentences.en: Rebecca's study of the Elgin homes, along with the work of other researchers like Rose Thornton, our architectural historian,
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡对埃尔金住宅的研究，连同我们的建筑历史学家罗斯·桑顿（Rose Thornton）等其他研究人员的工作，

sentences.en: would help to launch what has become a Sears house hunting movement.
sentences.zh: 将有助于发起一场如今已成气候的“西尔斯寻房运动”。

sentences.en: People whose chief passion in life is to scour the land, trying to find as many kid homes as possible, including Rose.
sentences.zh: 那些人生主要热情就是搜寻这片土地，试图找到尽可能多西尔斯住宅的人们，包括罗斯在内。

sentences.en: Some people do crossword puzzles, and some people do jigsaw puzzles.
sentences.zh: 有些人喜欢做填字游戏，有些人喜欢拼图。

sentences.en: I guess I look for Sears homes.
sentences.zh: 我想我喜欢寻找西尔斯住宅。

sentences.en: Well, actually, me and Rose and Dale and Wendy and Andrew and Nigel and Cindy look for Sears houses.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，我和罗斯、戴尔、温迪、安德鲁、奈杰尔和辛迪都在寻找西尔斯住宅。

sentences.en: Those names form part of an elite core of the Sears house hunters, an A-team, if you will.
sentences.zh: 这些名字构成了一个精英西尔斯寻房核心小组，如果你愿意的话，可以称之为“A小队”。

sentences.en: And like any proper A-team, each member has their specialty.
sentences.zh: 而且像任何正规的A小队一样，每个成员都有自己的专长。

sentences.en: Rosemary hunts for the rare Sears magnolia, the three-story colonial mansion.
sentences.zh: 罗斯玛丽（Rosemary）专门搜寻罕见的西尔斯“木兰”房型，那是一种三层楼的殖民风格豪宅。

sentences.en: So far, she says, they've found ten.
sentences.zh: 她说，到目前为止，他们已经找到了十栋。

sentences.en: Dale Wolke specializes in kid homes built by Sears' biggest competitor, the Aladdin Company.
sentences.zh: 戴尔·沃尔克（Dale Wolke）专门研究西尔斯最大的竞争对手——阿拉丁公司（Aladdin Company）建造的住宅。

sentences.en: And Andrew Mutch is the numbers guy.
sentences.zh: 而安德鲁·穆奇（Andrew Mutch）是负责数据的人。

sentences.en: He's currently working with about half a dozen people on a database that would list every single Sears.
sentences.zh: 他目前正与大约六个人合作建立一个数据库，列出每一栋西尔斯住宅。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Nigel Tate, at 19, is the youngest member of their team.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，19岁的奈杰尔·泰特（Nigel Tate）是他们团队中最年轻的成员。

sentences.en: He's found over 1,000 kid homes without even leaving his desk.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不用离开书桌就找到了1000多栋西尔斯住宅。

sentences.en: He uses Google Street View.
sentences.zh: 他使用的是谷歌街景。

sentences.en: But mostly, they hunt for houses the old-fashioned way.
sentences.zh: 但大多数时候，他们还是用老办法寻找房子。

sentences.en: Chasing down clues and betrolling the mean streets of America in a car, together.
sentences.zh: 一起开车追寻线索，穿梭在美国平凡的街道上。

sentences.en: And Andrew's up in front, and he's got his computer, and he's writing down addresses.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁坐在前面，拿着电脑记录地址。

sentences.en: And Dale is driving, and Wendy and I are in the back seat, each with a camera.
sentences.zh: 戴尔开车，温迪和我坐在后座，每人拿着一台相机。

sentences.en: And everybody's looking out the window, and somebody says,
sentences.zh: 每个人都盯着窗外，然后有人会说，

sentences.en: Hey, what's that over there on the right?
sentences.zh: 嘿，右边那个是什么？

sentences.en: Although, let's face it, they're not exactly bounty hunters.
sentences.zh: 虽然说实话，他们并不完全是赏金猎人。

sentences.en: And so I'm getting out, and I'm taking pictures, and this very large, angry man bursts out the front door.
sentences.zh: 所以我下车拍照，这时一个非常高大、愤怒的男人冲出了前门。

sentences.en: He has a baseball bat in his hand.
sentences.zh: 他手里拿着一根棒球棍。

sentences.en: We get in the car, and we take off.
sentences.zh: 我们上了车，然后逃之夭夭。

sentences.en: The occasional misstep aside, Rose and Rebecca think that they and other house hunters have helped identify nearly 50,000 kid homes from Sears and other companies.
sentences.zh: 撇开偶尔的失误不谈，罗斯和丽贝卡认为，她们和其他寻房者已经帮助确认了近5万栋来自西尔斯及其他公司的住宅。

sentences.en: So the next time a ragtag team of researchers armed with cameras, laptops, and an old Sears catalog knocks on your door and asks if they can take a quick tour of your basement,
sentences.zh: 所以，下次当一队拿着相机、笔记本电脑和旧西尔斯目录的杂牌研究人员敲你的门，问能不能快速参观一下你的地下室时，

sentences.en: don't be frightened.
sentences.zh: 不要害怕。

sentences.en: They're there to help.
sentences.zh: 他们是来帮忙的。

sentences.en: And who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: You might even be standing in an undiscovered model.
sentences.zh: 你可能正站在一栋尚未被发现的房型里。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a Sears schoolhouse?
sentences.zh: 你见过西尔斯的校舍吗？

sentences.en: Because I saw that they offered that one year.
sentences.zh: 因为我看到他们有一年提供过那种房型。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I've been looking for that a long time.
sentences.zh: 我找那个找了很久了。

sentences.en: Good Lord.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I've been hunting that thing down like it's my job.
sentences.zh: 我一直在追寻那个东西，就像那是我的工作一样。

sentences.en: Sears homes aren't the only Sears architecture dotting the landscape.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯住宅并不是点缀在这片土地上的唯一西尔斯建筑。

sentences.en: Kurt and I talk about the adaptive reuse of massive Sears buildings all across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我和库尔特（Kurt）谈论了全美各地大型西尔斯建筑的适应性再利用。

sentences.en: After this.
sentences.zh: 稍后回来。

sentences.en: Years before Kurt Kolstad joined the team at 99% Invisible, he and I started corresponding by email.
sentences.zh: 在库尔特·科尔斯塔德（Kurt Kolstad）加入《99%隐形》（99% Invisible）团队的前几年，我们就开始通过电子邮件通信了。

sentences.en: Among other things, he sometimes sent over story ideas.
sentences.zh: 除其他事项外，他有时会发来故事创意。

sentences.en: And one of those was about an old Sears building he moved into in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 其中一个就是关于他搬进明尼阿波利斯的一栋旧西尔斯大楼。

sentences.en: It's not a Sears home.
sentences.zh: 那不是西尔斯住宅。

sentences.en: It's a Sears plant, a huge city block sized warehouse, distribution center, and retail store.
sentences.zh: 那是一个西尔斯工厂，一个占地一整个街区的巨大仓库、配送中心和零售店。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And when I was really young, I used to actually go shopping in this thing.
sentences.zh: 我小时候真的会去那里购物。

sentences.en: It was this 12 story Art Deco Sears.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋12层的装饰艺术风格西尔斯大楼。

sentences.en: I'd go there with my parents.
sentences.zh: 我会和父母一起去那里。

sentences.en: But for most of my years in Minnesota, it was just an abandoned building.
sentences.zh: 但在我在明尼苏达州的大部分时间里，它只是一栋废弃的建筑。

sentences.en: I used to bike for miles along this overgrown railroad track that ran past the building in a trench.
sentences.zh: 我过去常沿着这条长满杂草的铁轨骑行数英里，铁轨在沟槽中穿过大楼。

sentences.en: And at the time, that big complex was kind of this ominous presence that you just kind of slip past on your bike and, you know, not get too close to.
sentences.zh: 当时，那个庞大的建筑群就像一种不祥的存在，你骑车经过时只会匆匆溜过，你知道的，不敢靠得太近。

sentences.en: So you basically don't engage with it at all.
sentences.zh: 所以你基本上根本不会去接触它。

sentences.en: It's not really something like you go up to.
sentences.zh: 它真的不是那种你会走近的地方。

sentences.en: You just cycle past it quickly.
sentences.zh: 你只是快速骑车经过它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's just, you know, and it took multiple city blocks.
sentences.zh: 它就是，你知道的，它占据了多个街区。

sentences.en: So it was really kind of, you know, between the parking lot and the building, it was just this big empty presence in the city.
sentences.zh: 所以它真的，你知道，在停车场和大楼之间，它只是城市中一个巨大的空洞存在。

sentences.en: And then suddenly, you know, I moved back to the Midwest years later, and this place is totally transformed.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间，你知道，多年后我搬回中西部，这个地方完全变了样。

sentences.en: It had been renamed the Midtown Exchange, and it was full of all these little shops and eateries on the main floor, plus offices and apartments and condos above.
sentences.zh: 它被重新命名为“中城交易所”（Midtown Exchange），主楼层挤满了各种小商店和餐馆，楼上还有办公室、公寓和共管公寓。

sentences.en: And those old rail tracks that I'd biked along had been cleared and paved and turned into this five-mile greenway, which was really neat.
sentences.zh: 而我曾经骑行经过的那些旧铁轨已经被清理、铺平，变成了这条五英里长的绿道，真的很棒。

sentences.en: It's sort of this ready-made rails-to-trails conversion.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种现成的“废弃铁路转绿道”改造。

sentences.en: And I got really interested in this, not just as a building, but also as an urban phenomena, right?
sentences.zh: 我对这个很感兴趣，不仅是作为一个建筑，也是作为一个城市现象，对吧？

sentences.en: Like how they had turned this nothing into a something again.
sentences.zh: 就像他们是如何把这个“无”再次变成“有”的。

sentences.en: So I naturally, being an architecture geek, started digging into the history of Sears.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个建筑极客，我自然开始挖掘西尔斯的历史。

sentences.en: So what did you find in your research?
sentences.zh: 那么你在研究中发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, for starters, Richard Warren Sears himself was born in Minnesota, where he actually started selling watches in the late 1800s.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，理查德·沃伦·西尔斯（Richard Warren Sears）本人出生在明尼苏达州，他实际上是在19世纪末在那里开始卖手表的。

sentences.en: Then over time, he moved operations to Chicago and started growing out this larger mail order business.
sentences.zh: 后来随着时间的推移，他将业务转移到芝加哥，并开始发展这种更大规模的邮购业务。

sentences.en: And it basically became the Amazon of the early 20th century.
sentences.zh: 它基本上成为了20世纪初的亚马逊。

sentences.en: And in the 1920s, they started branching out even more, adding retail outlets to their distribution centers all the way from, you know, Boston to Seattle.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪20年代，他们开始进一步扩张，将零售网点添加到从波士顿到西雅图等各地的配送中心中。

sentences.en: And you've shown me pictures of these.
sentences.zh: 你给我看过这些照片。

sentences.en: They all look surprisingly similar, even though they're, like, scattered across the entire U.S.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来惊人地相似，尽管它们散布在整个美国。

sentences.en: They have some different brick styles, but they're all kind of boxy.
sentences.zh: 它们有一些不同的砖块风格，但它们都显得方方正正的。

sentences.en: They have big windows and other details in common, including these really great, distinctive art deco-style towers.
sentences.zh: 它们有共同的大窗户和其他细节，包括这些非常棒、独特的装饰艺术风格塔楼。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, they look a little bit like castle towers or something.
sentences.zh: 是的，它们看起来有点像城堡塔楼之类的东西。

sentences.en: And they're a big giveaway if you're, you know, hunting these kinds of Sears buildings.
sentences.zh: 如果你在寻找这类西尔斯建筑，它们是一个很大的标志。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And they served a function, too.
sentences.zh: 而且它们也有功能性。

sentences.en: They basically concealed these huge water cisterns that then serve the floors below.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上隐藏了这些巨大的蓄水池，然后为下面的楼层供水。

sentences.en: And, yeah, once you know, you know, the towers and these other details, you can really easily start to spot other towers in other cities.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，一旦你知道了，你知道，塔楼和这些其他细节，你就能很容易地开始在其他城市发现其他塔楼。

sentences.en: And a lot of that commonality traces back to this one architect in particular, George Kroll Nimmin's.
sentences.zh: 而这种共同点很大程度上可以追溯到一位特定的建筑师，乔治·克罗尔·尼明斯（George Kroll Nimmons）。

sentences.en: And he did a lot of work for Sears.
sentences.zh: 他为西尔斯做了很多工作。

sentences.en: You know, he even designed at one point a mansion for the company's president.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他甚至一度为公司总裁设计了一座豪宅。

sentences.en: But he's mostly known for his big-scale commercial work.
sentences.zh: 但他最出名的是他的大型商业作品。

sentences.en: And among other things, he worked on this really big early plant and administrative hub for Sears in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 除其他事项外，他参与了西尔斯在芝加哥的一个非常大的早期工厂和行政中心的设计。

sentences.en: But this is not the Sears Tower of Chicago or the now Willis Tower.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是芝加哥的西尔斯大厦，也就是现在的威利斯大厦（Willis Tower）。

sentences.en: It's something else.
sentences.zh: 那是另一回事。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: That actually came many decades later.
sentences.zh: 那实际上是几十年后才出现的。

sentences.en: But amazingly, it was only like half again as big as this really old complex that, you know, nobody really knows about.
sentences.zh: 但令人惊讶的是，它只比这个没人真正知道的古老建筑群大了一倍半左右。

sentences.en: The old complex was built a bit west of downtown.
sentences.zh: 那个古老的建筑群建在市中心以西一点的地方。

sentences.en: And it was about 3 million square feet.
sentences.zh: 它大约有300万平方英尺。

sentences.en: The company boasted that it was the largest commercial complex in the world at the time.
sentences.zh: 该公司吹嘘它是当时世界上最大的商业建筑群。

sentences.en: And it spanned multiple blocks.
sentences.zh: 它横跨了多个街区。

sentences.en: It covered existing streets.
sentences.zh: 它覆盖了现有的街道。

sentences.en: So it actually blocked off city streets.
sentences.zh: 所以它实际上阻断了城市街道。

sentences.en: And they had to get special permission, of course, from the city to do that.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们必须获得市政府的特别许可才能这样做。

sentences.en: And the place basically functioned like a city within the city.
sentences.zh: 这个地方基本上就像城中之城一样运作。

sentences.en: It had its own power plant.
sentences.zh: 它有自己的发电厂。

sentences.en: It had its own corporate, you know, employee-based fire department.
sentences.zh: 它有自己的企业员工消防部门。

sentences.en: And it even had its own radio station, WLS, short for World's Largest Store.
sentences.zh: 它甚至有自己的广播电台WLS，即“世界最大商店”（World's Largest Store）的缩写。

sentences.en: Oh, I love that it had its own commercial radio station.
sentences.zh: 哦，我喜欢它拥有自己的商业广播电台这一点。

sentences.en: That's so great.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, they got sick of basically buying airtime on other radio stations.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们基本上厌倦了在其他广播电台购买播出时间。

sentences.en: And eventually they were like, hey, you know what?
sentences.zh: 最终他们想，嘿，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We'll just start our own radio station.
sentences.zh: 我们自己开个广播电台吧。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Because, you know, at the time, Sears is this giant.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，当时西尔斯是一个巨人。

sentences.en: It's America's biggest retailer.
sentences.zh: 它是美国最大的零售商。

sentences.en: And they just kept expanding, too.
sentences.zh: 而且他们一直在扩张。

sentences.en: They kept following kind of where the country took them.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在跟随国家发展的步伐。

sentences.en: At first, they did mail order where they served rural populations.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们做邮购业务，服务于农村人口。

sentences.en: Then they added these mixed-use plants with retail outlets to serve cities.
sentences.zh: 然后他们增加了这些带有零售网点的混合用途工厂来服务城市。

sentences.en: And then as people moved out to the suburbs, you know, they began to go into these shopping centers.
sentences.zh: 随着人们搬到郊区，你知道，他们开始进入这些购物中心。

sentences.en: Today, obviously, Sears is not doing quite as well.
sentences.zh: 今天，显然，西尔斯的表现不太好。

sentences.en: And a lot of that complex in Chicago, for example, has been torn down.
sentences.zh: 例如，芝加哥的那个建筑群大部分已经被拆除了。

sentences.en: But some parts are still around.
sentences.zh: 但有些部分仍然存在。

sentences.en: And some have even been reused, including that central iconic tower.
sentences.zh: 有些甚至被重新利用了，包括那个标志性的中央塔楼。

sentences.en: Because it's really hard to reuse a million-plus square feet inside of a city.
sentences.zh: 因为在城市内部重新利用一百多万平方英尺的空间真的很难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's incredibly difficult and almost impossible to find a single corporate client who could take that on.
sentences.zh: 要找到一个能承担起这种项目的企业客户，简直难如登天，几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: And so, like the one in Minneapolis, for instance, it had to bring in all these different stakeholders, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，就像明尼阿波利斯的那个项目一样，它必须引入各种不同的利益相关方，你知道，

sentences.en: a local hospital and get the city on board and other developers so that, you know, there was a plan to make it mixed-use from the start.
sentences.zh: 比如当地的一家医院，还要让市政府参与进来，以及其他开发商，这样从一开始就能制定出混合用途的规划。

sentences.en: But these buildings also have some advantages, too, for adaptive reuse.
sentences.zh: 但这些建筑在适应性再利用方面也有一些优势。

sentences.en: You know, they're built of sturdy concrete and masonry.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们是用坚固的混凝土和砖石建造的。

sentences.en: And they get a lot of light on all sides because they have these huge windows.
sentences.zh: 而且因为有巨大的窗户，各个方向的采光都非常好。

sentences.en: And so, when you wrote me years and years and years ago, it was in part a story about how cities are reusing these Sears buildings.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你多年前给我写信时，那在某种程度上是一个关于城市如何再利用这些西尔斯百货大楼的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's what really fascinates me the moSt.
sentences.zh: 而这正是最让我着迷的地方。

sentences.en: It's not just, you know, that they're being reused, but it's the stories that they tell about the different cities they're being reused in.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为它们被再利用了，更重要的是它们讲述了各自所在城市的不同故事。

sentences.en: So, in some ways, it's like this big urban experiment.
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上，这就像是一个巨大的城市实验。

sentences.en: You know, if you put these different boxes that all look kind of the same and are all, you know, sort of similar in size,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你把这些看起来大同小异、规模也差不多的盒子，

sentences.en: and you spread them out across the country and you abandon them, you know, what happens?
sentences.zh: 散布在全国各地，然后又把它们废弃掉，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: And it turns out that you get these very city-specific stories of abandonment and reuse that tell you something about these different places.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，你会得到这些极具城市特色的废弃与再利用的故事，它们能让你了解这些不同的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, what are some of your favorites?
sentences.zh: 那么，你最喜欢其中的哪些案例呢？

sentences.en: What did you discover?
sentences.zh: 你发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, in Seattle, famous for its coffee, there's an old plant south of downtown that's been transformed into the headquarters of Starbucks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在以咖啡闻名的西雅图，市中心南边有一座旧工厂被改造成了星巴克的总部。

sentences.en: And the Los Angeles plant is being renovated right now, but for a long time, it was basically down to just the retail store on the ground floor,
sentences.zh: 而洛杉矶的那座工厂目前正在翻新，但在很长一段时间里，它基本上只剩下底层的零售店了，

sentences.en: and the rest of the building was empty.
sentences.zh: 大楼的其他部分都是空的。

sentences.en: But, of course, even, you know, an empty building, when you're talking about Hollywood, has a function.
sentences.zh: 但当然，你知道，即使是一栋空楼，在好莱坞，它也有它的功能。

sentences.en: You know, you can rent it out for filming.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以把它租出去拍电影。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, it became a filming location.
sentences.zh: 所以，它成了一个拍摄场地。

sentences.en: And then a lot of cities sort of followed the Minneapolis example, and Boston was the first one to do it, where they just said, you know,
sentences.zh: 后来很多城市都效仿了明尼阿波利斯的做法，波士顿是第一个这么做的，他们当时就说，你知道，

sentences.en: we have to bring in a bunch of different programs to make this work for our city.
sentences.zh: 我们必须引入一系列不同的项目才能让它在我们的城市行得通。

sentences.en: So, they, you know, had theaters and sports complexes and daycare centers, and Memphis and Minneapolis and other cities followed suit.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们引入了剧院、体育中心和托儿所，孟菲斯、明尼阿波利斯和其他城市也纷纷效仿。

sentences.en: And so, there's a little Sears building in Uptown Oakland, what we call Uptown, if you drive up Telegraph, or away from beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 在奥克兰上城区，也就是我们所说的上城区，如果你沿着电报大道往上走，或者远离美丽的加州奥克兰市中心，就会看到一座小型的西尔斯大楼。

sentences.en: Towards beautiful Uptown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 朝着美丽的加州奥克兰上城区走。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You'll see a little one.
sentences.zh: 你会看到一座小的。

sentences.en: And what did they use that one for?
sentences.zh: 那他们把那座楼用作什么了？

sentences.en: So, that place is really small, and it's called the Telegraph Lofts, and basically, they're live-work units.
sentences.zh: 那个地方很小，叫“电报阁楼”，基本上是商住两用单元。

sentences.en: So, they're residential units, and there's some self-storage and other stuff, but mainly, it's residential.
sentences.zh: 所以它们是住宅单元，还有一些自助仓储之类的设施，但主要是住宅。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Which is probably the thing we need the most in the Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 这可能是湾区目前最需要的东西。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If there are empty buildings to be reused here, I would hope we could just turn them all into more housing.
sentences.zh: 如果这里有空置的建筑可以再利用，我真希望我们能把它们全部改造成住房。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thanks, Kurt.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，库尔特。

sentences.zh: 嗯。
